source_text: Empirical data indicate that in uncircumcised cohorts, self-resolved or conservatively managed cases predominate, challenging claims of universal medical necessity and highlighting how cultural biases—such as parental expectations of early retraction by age 1 in 66% of surveyed families—drive unnecessary interventions despite evidence of natural resolution. [91] [83]
